verdict.rationale: AgentMail's docs state that its SDKs are open source under the MIT license, so users can read part of the product's own code under an open license. However, AgentMail is a hosted email service, and nothing indicates the core service (server, API backend, MCP server, CLI) is open source. missing for 10: open-source availability of the core service, MCP server and CLI, a public repository link or license file evidence, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: All of our SDKs are open source and available under the MIT license.
